captcha.click: Please confirm briefly that you are human.
captcha.title: Security check

welcome.title: HolidayVote
welcome.text: Choose the holiday home together – without link chaos in the group chat.
welcome.newHint: Collect holiday homes and invite family or friends
welcome.invitedHint: Join right away with the code from the invitation

collect.title: Collect links
collect.text: Found a holiday home on Airbnb, Booking, Vrbo & co.? Paste the link – title, description and preview picture come from the page. The picture stays on your phone only.

vote.title: Rate together
vote.text: Everyone gives 1–5 stars, can pick a favourite and set a veto. Comments settle the rest.

decide.title: Decide
decide.text: The list sorts itself by rating, vetoes and price. Whoever created the vacation marks the house that was booked.

first.title: Your first vacation
first.text: What's your name, and where are you going? You can add the destination later, too.

join.title: Join a vacation
join.text: Enter the code from the invitation. The group's holiday homes and ratings come along automatically.
join.noCode: No code? The person inviting you finds it in HolidayVote in the vacation under “Invite”.

recover.title: Restore vacations
recover.text: Enter your recovery code. You created and saved it in HolidayVote under Settings → “New or lost phone?”.
recover.noCode: No code? Ask to be invited again and choose “I was invited”.

vacations.title: Vacations
vacations.emptyText: Create a vacation and collect holiday homes – or join one with an invite code.

vacation.name: Name
vacation.emptyText: Paste the link to a holiday home – and invite the others so everyone can rate.
vacation.onlyHere: So far this vacation is only on your phone. As soon as you invite someone, it is uploaded.
vacation.fieldsHint: Applies to everyone in this vacation: which details appear in the form and on the cards.
vacation.leaveText: Your stars, veto and favourite are removed. Your comments stay.
vacation.leaveTextOwner: The person who has been in it longest takes over the vacation. Your stars, veto and favourite are removed.
vacation.deleteText: The vacation with all houses, ratings and comments is deleted.
vacation.deleteTextShared: The vacation is deleted for everyone – with all houses, ratings and comments.

property.houseUnavailable: This holiday home is not available on this device. Try syncing again, or return to your vacations.
property.houseLoadFailed: The holiday home couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
property.linkHint: Copy the link from Airbnb, Booking, Vrbo, Novasol or any other site and paste it here.
property.noLinkInClipboard: There's no link in the clipboard.
property.pasteFailed: Can't paste – please tap into the field and paste there.
property.duplicate: This house is already in the list: {{title}}
property.previewFailed: The page doesn't offer a preview. Just enter the title and details yourself and pick an icon below.
property.title: Title
property.locateHint: Check address fills in the matching address. Save also checks automatically (only the address is sent to OpenStreetMap).
property.addressSavedWithoutPin: Address saved, but no map pin could be added. You can check the address again later.
property.saveFailed: The house couldn't be saved. Please try again.
property.avatarHint: Shown when the page provides no preview picture.
property.deleteText: The house disappears for everyone – with ratings and comments.
property.previewRefreshFailed: The page offers no preview right now – the previous one stays.
property.previewTemporary: This text comes from the listing page and is not stored. Take over what's relevant into title and description yourself.
property.addPictureManually: No image from the listing page visible? You can add your own photo (gallery or camera).
property.sharedPickVacationHint: Choose the vacation the shared holiday home is added to.
property.sharedNoVacations: You have no vacation yet. Create one first.
property.sharedTitleUnavailable: Couldn't read the name. Please check or enter the title before saving.
property.sharedLinkInvalid: The shared item doesn't contain a valid holiday-home link (http or https).
property.sharedLinkError: Couldn't read or dismiss the shared link. Please reopen the app to try again.

votes.pickHint: Per vacation you have one favourite and one veto. If you set them elsewhere, they move along.

veto.moveText: You already set your veto on another house. It moves here.

map.empty: No houses on the map yet. Enter an address for a house and save it to look up its location.

sharing.inviteHint: Everyone invited can add houses, rate and comment. The organiser marks houses as booked or eliminated.
sharing.inviteText: Send the invitation to the group: whoever taps the link goes straight to your vacation. Without the link: open HolidayVote → “I was invited” → enter the code.
sharing.inviteShareText: Help us pick the holiday home for “{{vacation}}”! Join in HolidayVote with the code {{code}}:

setup.text: No account, no e-mail, no password: your phone gets an anonymous access. You only need a name the others will see.

sharing.privacyNote: Vacations, links (with the page's title and description), ratings and comments are transferred encrypted and stored on our server in the EU – visible only to the people in your vacation. Pictures of the holiday homes are never uploaded.
sharing.deviceNote: Your vacations belong to this phone. For a new phone: create a recovery code below and keep it safe.
sharing.notConfigured: Sharing is not set up in this version yet.

error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired.
error.other_account: This device already belongs to another account.
error.timeout: The vacation didn't arrive – please check your internet connection.
error.failed: That didn't work. Please check your internet connection and try again later.
error.terms_required: Please accept the terms of use first.
error.blocked: Can't join: someone in this vacation is blocked by you or has blocked you.
error.invalid_recovery_code: This recovery code is not correct.
error.captcha: The security check didn't work. Please try again – and if it still fails, update HolidayVote.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.

ugc.acceptSuffix: : no objectionable, abusive or illegal content. Violations lead to removal.
ugc.reportAfterSharing: Reporting is possible once the vacation is shared.
ugc.reported: Thanks for reporting. We review reports within 24 hours.
ugc.blockText: You leave this vacation and can't share a vacation with this person again. We get a report.
ugc.blockTextOwner: The person is removed from the vacation and can't share a vacation with you again. We get a report.

recovery.title: New or lost phone?
recovery.text: With your recovery code you get your vacations back on a new phone – everything, also as organiser. The old phone loses access.
recovery.later: New or lost phone? Once you have invited someone or joined a vacation, you can create a recovery code here.
recovery.renewText: Your previous code will stop working.
recovery.keepSafe: Keep it safe now, e.g. in a password manager or your notes – it is shown only this once. Whoever has the code can take over your place.
recovery.shareText: My HolidayVote recovery code: {{code}} – on a new phone choose “New phone? Restore vacations” at the start.

settings.title: Settings
settings.localOnly: So far your vacations are only on this phone. As soon as you invite someone or join, they are uploaded.
settings.homeHint: For “distance from home” on the houses. Stays on this phone only.
settings.deleteHint: Deletes your account, your data on the server and everything on this phone. Vacations that others are still in stay for them.
settings.deleteText: Your account, your ratings and all data on this phone are deleted. Vacations that only belong to you are deleted completely. This can't be undone.
